facts.value: Physical exercise is important for maintaining physical fitness and can contribute to maintaining a healthy weight, regulating the digestive system, building and maintaining healthy bone density, muscle strength, and joint mobility, promoting physiological well-being, reducing surgical risks, and strengthening the immune system.
facts.programme_association: Exercise and Health Fitness Management - BSc

facts.value: Some studies indicate that exercise may increase life expectancy and the overall quality of life.
facts.programme_association: Exercise and Health Fitness Management - BSc

facts.value: People who participate in moderate to high levels of physical exercise have a lower mortality rate compared to individuals who by comparison are not physically active.
facts.programme_association: Exercise and Health Fitness Management - BSc

facts.value: Moderate levels of exercise have been correlated with preventing aging by reducing inflammatory potential.
facts.programme_association: Exercise and Health Fitness Management - BSc

facts.value: The majority of the benefits from exercise are achieved with around 3500 metabolic equivalent (MET) minutes per week, with diminishing returns at higher levels of activity.
facts.programme_association: Exercise and Health Fitness Management - BSc

facts.value: Climbing stairs 10 minutes, vacuuming 15 minutes, gardening 20 minutes, running 20 minutes, and walking or bicycling for transportation 25 minutes on a daily basis would together achieve about 3000 MET minutes a week.
facts.programme_association: Exercise and Health Fitness Management - BSc

facts.value: Only doing half the usual recommended level exercise still reduces the risk of early death, cardiovascular disease, stroke, and cancer.
facts.programme_association: Exercise and Health Fitness Management - BSc

facts.value: A lack of physical activity causes approximately 6% of the burden of disease from coronary heart disease, 7% of type 2 diabetes, 10% of breast cancer, and 10% of colon cancer worldwide.
facts.programme_association: Exercise and Health Fitness Management - BSc

facts.value: Overall, physical inactivity causes 9% of premature mortality worldwide.
facts.programme_association: Exercise and Health Fitness Management - BSc

facts.value: If someone invented a pill that could do for us all that a moderate amount of exercise achieves, it would instantly become the most successful drug in history.
facts.programme_association: Exercise and Health Fitness Management - BSc
